subject: humanities
passage: Before the twelfth century, the stone walls of large European churches had to be thick and their windows relatively small, because the walls bore the full outward push of the heavy stone vaults overhead. Gothic builders found a way around this ______ shifting much of that push onto flying buttresses, external arches that carried the load down to piers standing away from the building, they were able to open the walls themselves to vast panels of stained glass.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "Gothic builders found a way around this problem" is an independent clause, and so is "by shifting much of that push onto flying buttresses ..., they were able to open the walls." The second clause explains what the way around the problem was. A colon can join two independent clauses when the second explains the first.
explanation.A: Incorrect. The commas leave two independent clauses, "Gothic builders found a way" and "they were able to open the walls," joined only by commas; this is a comma splice.
explanation.B: Incorrect. With no punctuation, the two independent clauses run together as a run-on sentence.
explanation.C: Correct. The colon joins the two independent clauses, and the second clause explains how the builders got around the problem.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A colon can't separate the preposition "by" from its object, "shifting much of that push."
